releases.name: Version 2.2.0
releases.body:
# v2.2.0
## Improvements
* [Add Chinese Translation#3](https://github.com/TRSasasusu/Finis/pull/3) by @SanBaiMing ! Thank you!
* Add a hidden scroll near the starting point.

## Fixes
* Finally fix the softlocking issue! I cannot reproduce it, but I was sure that it was caused by the specific star system, so I moved the final sequence into the Jam 3 system! The issue cannot occur anymore, I believe.
releases.bodyZh:
# v2.2.0
## 改善
* [Add Chinese Translation#3](https://github.com/TRSasasusu/Finis/pull/3) by @SanBaiMing ! ありがとうございます!
* 開始地点の近くに隠し巻物を追加しました。

## 修正
* ついにソフトロックの問題を修正しました！ 再現できませんが、特定の星系が原因であると確信していたので、最終シーケンスをジャム3星系に移しました！ この問題はもう発生しないと思います。

* Set the correct lifespan on the specific explosion to work on the latest New Horizons.
* In related to #2, set Band Together as conflicts as a temporary solution.
releases.bodyZh:
# v2.1.3
## 改善
* Finis Plateauの核のReferenceFrameを無効化。
## 修正
* 最新のNew Horizonsに対応するために、特定の爆発の正しい寿命を設定。
* 2番目の問題に関連して、暫定的な解決策としてBand Togetherをコンフリクトとして設定。

releases.name: Version 2.1.0
releases.body:
Finis is really finished. Finis has an ending sequence in a specific place now.

# v2.1.0
## Improvements
* **Add an ending sequence in the specific place after entering the specific black hole.**
* Complete updating ship log cards.
* Improve the appearance of the specific cannon.
* A specific moon has inverseSquared gravity to enter more easily.
* Japanese translation is completed.
## Fixes
* Fix incompatibility with Immersion (#1). Thank you, @Owen013
* A specific rock cannot completely prevent entering of the ship, so it is fixed.
* After loading another system, the mechanism of Finis are broken, so it is fixed.
* In some monitor, the rod covers the translation tool, so it is fixed.

releases.name: Version 2.0.1
releases.body:
I had only 20 sec. when writing the release notes in the previous release. So, I write again the release notes in v2.0.0 in addition to v2.0.1.

# v2.0.1
## Improvements
* Improve the appearance of the planet with trees and rocks.
* Update ship log cards. (But some cards have not been updated yet.)
* Add more bodies and weapons to the specific place.
* Update the thumbnail.
## Fixes
* A specific moon does not have any ship logs in the map mode, so it is fixed.
* A specific Nomai text is not displayed correctly, so it is fixed.
* A specific Nomai text can be read in incorrect ways, so it is fixed.

# v2.0.0
## Improvements
* Add a specific moon.
* Add Ernesto, who loves very strong gravity. They mentions *a specific misleading existed in v1*.
* Colorize "community" in a specific Nomai text.
* Add many ship log facts along with Nomai texts.
* Improve narratives by these improvements.
* Improve the appearance of the planet with materials and Nomai props.
